contract.title: D007: Three-phase two-level grid-tie inverter -> controlled sinusoidal current
contract.prompt: Build a physical two-level three-phase grid-connected voltage-source inverter. A 700 V DC source must feed a six-switch bridge, and each AC phase must connect through a 7 mH, 1.5 ohm coupling reactor to a balanced 230 V line-to-line RMS, 50 Hz grid. Use 7 A RMS per phase as the current base. Read normalized scalar Id_ref_cmd, Iq_ref_cmd, and Vgrid_scale from base-workspace variables. Their nominal values are -1, 0, and 1 pu; Id_ref_cmd operates from -1.2 to -0.8 pu, Iq_ref_cmd from -0.5 to 0.5 pu, and Vgrid_scale from 0.9 to 1.1 pu. Regulate converter-to-grid current in closed loop from physical current measurements so its active and quadrature components follow the commands throughout the stated range, including when grid-voltage magnitude changes. Negative Id_ref_cmd denotes exported active current; positive Iq_ref_cmd denotes lagging current and negative Iq_ref_cmd leading current. Current regulation must establish promptly after startup, and grid current must remain balanced and reasonably sinusoidal. Log physical Timeseries Vout and Igrid. Each must contain all three measured grid phases in the same phase order, and Igrid is positive from converter to grid.
